title: Ancient Architects on the Giza water table

tellings.quote: So this is courtesy of Ancient Architects, another individual in the community who basically debunked debunked the study.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, discusses a study claiming a huge energy network lies beneath the pyramids of Giza in Egypt. He says another figure in the same community, who goes by Ancient Architects, debunked that study using the water table, the level of underground water beneath the site.
